name: Etapp 13: Risön to Lövstabruk

description.long: Naturkartan and Upplandsstiftelsen give 16.5 km. Downloaded GPX computes to about 16.211 km and is stored in the reverse direction, Lövstabruk-to-Risön.

utilities: Mapped facilities on this section include shelter, water, toilet, rest area, fireplace, campsite, swimming, heritage, parking, transit, attraction, rule warning, food.
waterSources: Use listed water rows as planning-grade refill information; seasonal access, non-potable warnings, and local signage override static data.
notes: Naturkartan and Upplandsstiftelsen give 16.5 km. Downloaded GPX computes to about 16.211 km and is stored in the reverse direction, Lövstabruk-to-Risön.
Use the Naturkartan Etapp 13 GPX as primary geometry.
Reverse the raw GPX point order for written walking direction, since the file is stored Lövstabruk-to-Risön while official prose says Risön-to-Lövstabruk.
Keep the single official track/segment intact; the one >500 m first stored step near Lövstabruk is a generalized geometry step, not evidence of a missing section.
Dedupe Risön endpoint services with Etapp 12/Floranslingan and Lövstabruk endpoint services with Etapp 14.

facilities.name: Öppen raststuga, Risön
facilities.description: Open rest/overnight cabin with two beds, electric heat and no cooking. Shared endpoint service with Etapp 12 and Floranslingan; dedupe by source URL/coordinate.

facilities.name: Vatten, Risön
facilities.description: Seasonal tap on the wall of one building at Risön; water is on from 1 May to 31 October / May-October. Shared endpoint service with Etapp 12 and Floranslingan.

facilities.name: Torrtoalett, Risön
facilities.description: Public dry toilet at Risön. Keep separate from bookable indoor WC/showers in the rental accommodation context. Shared endpoint service with Etapp 12 and Floranslingan.

facilities.name: Rastplats, Risön
facilities.description: Risön is the start farm/rest spot for Etapp 13 with outdoor visitor services. Indoor lodging/kitchen/showers are bookable amenities and are not public trail facilities.

facilities.name: Grillplats, Risön
facilities.description: Outdoor grill/fireplace at Risön. Florarna reserve rules allow fires only at prepared places and current fire-risk rules still apply.

facilities.name: Tältplats, Risön
facilities.description: Public tenting possibility at Risön, distinct from bookable indoor lodging. Shared endpoint service with Etapp 12 and Floranslingan.

facilities.name: Grillplats, Finnsjön
facilities.description: Prepared fireplace at the Finnsjön rest area. Naturkartan's current June 2025 notice says firewood is in a wood box 600 m west along the trail, away from the lake, and signs are planned.

facilities.name: Rastplats, Finnsjön
facilities.description: Rest area with bench and lake view in the northern part of Finnsjön, where the trail leaves the lakeside path.

facilities.name: Toalett, Lövstabruk
facilities.description: Shared Lövstabruk endpoint service from the Etapp 14 object page; relevant to Etapp 13 finish and must be deduplicated with Etapp 14. Listed as available May-October with opening-hour variation.

facilities.name: Vatten, Lövstabruk
facilities.description: Shared Lövstabruk endpoint drinking-water service from the Etapp 14 object page. Seasonal May-October with opening-hour variation; dedupe with Etapp 14.

facilities.name: Badplats, Södra Bruksdammen
facilities.description: Endpoint bathing place near road 76/Lövstabruk, supported by Tierp municipality with jetty, diving tower, grill, tables/benches and safety equipment. Coordinate is municipal bathing-place coordinate rather than a Naturkartan object.

facilities.name: Lövstabruk bruksmiljö
facilities.description: Stage endpoint in the historic Lövstabruk ironworks environment with manor, workers' houses, church, offices, dams and preserved 1700s mill setting. Use one heritage POI rather than importing each visitor attraction separately.

facilities.name: Nybron och gamla banvallen mot Lövstabruk
facilities.description: Route-feature POI at the old railway embankment turn described in official prose. Coordinate is snapped to the GPX around the route-text location near Nybron, not to a separately verified heritage marker.

facilities.name: Informella badplatser längs Finnsjön
facilities.description: Official route prose says there are several good places to swim along Finnsjön, but no discrete official bathing-place marker was found. Keep as context unless the app supports narrative swim areas or a precise source is found. Promoted during Upplandsleden normalization from a pending row under the current app policy.

facilities.name: Parkering, Risön
facilities.description: Parking for about 10 cars, plowed in winter. Access metadata only; do not import as a normal trail facility. Promoted during Upplandsleden normalization from a suppression row under the current app policy.

facilities.name: Parkering, norra Lövstabruk
facilities.description: Barnens Bruk/north Lövstabruk parking on private land for day visitors and passenger cars. Adjacent toilets belong to the visitor operation; do not infer a general public trail toilet from this row. Promoted during Upplandsleden normalization from a suppression row under the current app policy.

facilities.name: Busshållplats, Lövstabruk Herrgården
facilities.description: Transport metadata only. Official route page says buses run from Lövstabruk to Tierp, with onward Upptåget connection. Promoted during Upplandsleden normalization from a suppression row under the current app policy.

facilities.name: Risön booked indoor amenities
facilities.description: Risön indoor beds, kitchen, hot/cold water, showers and WC belong to bookable accommodation/rental context. Public trail services are represented separately as open cabin, dry toilet, seasonal water, tenting, fireplace and rest area. Promoted during Upplandsleden normalization from a suppression row under the current app policy.

facilities.name: Torpet Västergärde rental context
facilities.description: Bookable/rental accommodation context in Florarna. It is not an Etapp 13 public shelter/campsite/service point and should not be normal-imported. Promoted during Upplandsleden normalization from a suppression row under the current app policy.

facilities.name: Florarna reserve rules
facilities.description: Reserve-wide rules/context only: fire only at prepared places, dogs leashed, no disturbing wildlife, no off-road motor vehicles/camping vehicles except roads/parking, and other local restrictions. Apply current fire-risk rules before using fireplaces. Promoted during Upplandsleden normalization from a suppression row under the current app policy.

facilities.name: Florarna nature reserve area context
facilities.description: Broad reserve context for the start area, not a stage-specific POI. Keep route-specific public services as separate Risön rows. Promoted during Upplandsleden normalization from a suppression row under the current app policy.

facilities.name: Lövstabruk seasonal visitor services
facilities.description: Official route prose says Lövstabruk has summer inn/accommodation.
